headline: Czech Prime Minister Criticizes Central Bank Rate Hike as Scandalous
summary: Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis strongly criticized the central bank's recent interest rate hike, calling the board's decision scandalous and harmful to households and companies.
why: Central bank monetary policy decisions directly influence borrowing costs, inflation, and economic growth within a country.

impacts.name: Czech Republic
impacts.why: Central bank rate decisions alter domestic lending and policy interest rates.
